chapter.title: Outlaw Path (optional)
chapter.summary: Illegal work for the Headhunters, Vaughn and the Dead Saints. Every contract here is marked illegal.

objectives.title: Headhunters: "Wanna be a Headhunter?"
objectives.why: The Headhunters' entry contract in Pyro (+50 standing). Their work is illegal.

steps.do: In Contracts, move the slider to UNVERIFIED.
Accept and complete "Wanna be a Headhunter?".

objectives.title: Vaughn: "A Chance to Impress"
objectives.why: Vaughn's first assassination contract (+100 standing, +500 Assassination reputation).

steps.do: Accept "A Chance to Impress" from the Unverified list and complete it.

objectives.title: Dead Saints: "DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul"
objectives.why: The Dead Saints' trial smuggling haul (+50 Hauling reputation).

steps.do: Accept "DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul" from the Unverified list and deliver it.
